title: Cortex Speech dataset provenance ledger
description: Per-corpus license, consent, attribution and redistribution policy for every speech corpus the project ingests. Validated and enforced by scripts/verify_10.py: the license-compatibility gate fails the build when a share-alike-contaminating, NonCommercial, or no-redistribution corpus is marked for redistribution.

spdxLicense.description: SPDX license id of the source corpus.

shareAlike.description: True if the license is copyleft / share-alike (contaminates redistributed bundles).

attributionString.description: Exact attribution text to reproduce in dataset cards and exports.

consentBasis.description: Legal/ethical basis under which the speech was collected (e.g. explicit_voice_donation, public_terms_of_service, academic_release).

redistributionRights.description: What the project may legally do with the corpus.

takedownContact.description: Contact (URL or email) for takedown / consent-withdrawal requests.

datasetUsage.description: How build/export targets actually use this corpus. 'redistribute' = included in published dataset bundles; 'train_only' = used to fine-tune models but never shipped as data; 'reference_only' = used to compute reference transcripts/metrics; 'excluded' = present in the ledger but not used. The license-compatibility gate fails the build if a share-alike-contaminating, NonCommercial, or no-redistribution corpus is set to 'redistribute'.
